definitions.explanation: A natural spring of geothermally heated water, or a resort/facility built around such a spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I plan to go to a hot spring on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温泉|おんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many hot springs in Japan.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ると→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Taking a hot spring bath relieves fatigue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{温泉|おんせん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ってきた→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went on a hot spring trip with my family.
This hot spring is said to be good for the skin, and many people come from far away.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE: {温泉|おんせん} is deeply ingrained in Japanese culture. Japan has over 3,000 hot spring resorts due to its volcanic geography.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to take a hot spring bath)
- {温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a hot spring/spa)
- {温泉|おんせん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (hot spring trip)
- {温泉|おんせん}⟦{地|ち}→〜地：09852_chi⟧ (hot spring resort area)
- {温泉|おんせん}⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧/⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (hot spring inn)

TYPES OF {温泉|おんせん}:
- ⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧ (outdoor bath)
- ⟦{内湯|うちゆ}→内湯：noentry⟧ (indoor bath)
- ⟦{足湯|あしゆ}→足湯：14296_ashiyu⟧ (foot bath)

FAMOUS {温泉|おんせん} AREAS:
- ⟦{別府|べっぷ}→別府：noentry⟧, ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧, ⟦{草津|くさつ}→草津：noentry⟧, ⟦{有馬|ありま}→有馬：noentry⟧
